newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BK Group says raised Winterthur stake-RP.
newsitem.headline: BK Group says raised Winterthur stake-RP.

text.p: Swiss financier Martin Ebner said his BK Group of investment funds raised its stake in Winterthur Insurance Company to 18.3 percent as of June 30 from 14.5 percent in mid-May.
Ebner told reporters that around another five percent of Winterthur registered shares was held by customers advised by the BZ Bank, the bank arm of the BK Group.
But Ebner declined to say whether the group had been buying this week, when Winterthur shares jumped over 7.5 percent from Monday through Thursday's close at 1,438 Swiss francs.
"All I will say is that our participation in Winterthur is not lower today than it was on June 30," he told reporters late on Thursday at a briefing on his group's six-month results.
Ebner also declined to say whether the group planned to raise its holding in Winterthur.
The stake as of June 30 was held 11.3 percent by investment fund BK Vision and 7.0 percent by another fund, Stillhalter Vision.

In other major companies, executives told the briefing that BK Vision had raised its stake in registered shares of Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) to 25 percent at the end of June from 9.0 percent at the end of 1996.
At the same time it had disposed of its 5.3 percent holding of UBS bearer shares.
BK Vision also reduced its share in Zurich Insurance from 4.9 percent of registered shares as of December 31 to 3.1 percent at the end of June, BK Vision chief executive Kurt Schiltknecht said.
